review_notes: Head of אֹצָרוֹת → store houses moved from houses to store: rule 31 heads on the word whose loss loses the lexeme, and houses is the supplied generic here as place is in high place.

כְּ carries the conformity relation rendered According; אֲשֶׁר independently supplies the clause-linking as. Prefer this allocation to fused According as under rules 2, 11 and 30: removing According loses the conformity relation while removing as loses the clause linker, so each morpheme owns a distinct rendering.
אֲשֶׁר takes the clause-linking as separately from the conformity relation According rendered by כְּ (rules 2 and 11).
Margin 'wait for' read and set aside (rule 38).
